These small local excerpts exercise the real installed packaging grammars. They
are input data, not a substitute parser or a mock database.

- `unicode.txt`: local Unicode 17 ReadMe excerpt.
- `oewn.xml`: first lexical entry and original enclosing metadata from Open
  English WordNet 2025 plus (CC BY 4.0).
- `cili.ttl`: first local CILI/ODWN interchange statement and its prefixes.
- `semlink.json`, `semlink.jsonl`: local SemLink VN-to-FN mapping entries.
- `tatoeba.tab`, `sentences.attested`: first four local Tatoeba sentence records.
- `hatecheck.csv`: header and first two local HateCheck annotation rows.
- `ud.conllu`: first sentence of the local UD English EWT test data.
- `chess.pgn`: the existing workspace mate-in-one PGN fixture.

The raw recipes prove preservation of packaging bytes. The separate Tatoeba
recipe proves actual source-trunk claims and database-side consensus updates.
Full corpus semantic coverage is Gate C, after the Sprint 3 recipe rewrites.
